paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The average probing accuracy using different MLP variations. We indicate the size(s) of hidden layer(s) in square brackets.
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the average probing accuracy using different MLP variations for mBERT and XLM-R models, with the size(s) of hidden layer(s) indicated in square brackets on the horizontal axis, which is labeled with four categories: hidden:[50], linear; hidden:[], linear; hidden:[100], ReLU; and hidden:[50, 50], ReLU. The vertical axis is labeled "% point difference" and has a linear scale ranging from -0.2 to 0.2, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The chart displays grouped bars for each category, with light blue representing mBERT and dark blue representing XLM-R; the bars for hidden:[50], linear are at approximately -0.15 and -0.05, respectively; for hidden:[], linear, the bars are at around 0.08 and 0.2; for hidden:[100], ReLU, the bars are at about -0.1 and -0.03; and for hidden:[50, 50], ReLU, both bars are at approximately -0.15. The bars are grouped by category, with no specific sorting order or visual emphasis observed.
